records.title: HyDRA: Hybrid Dynamic Routing Architecture for Heterogeneous LLM Pools
records.reason: HyDRA predicts per-query capabilities and chooses the cheapest adequate model in heterogeneous production LLM pools, directly reducing deployment cost while reporting CPU router latency.
records.abstract_evidence_excerpt: Production LLM deployments increasingly maintain heterogeneous model pools spanning order-of-magnitude cost differences. Existing routers make binary strong-vs-weak decisions and couple learned parameters to specific model identities, requiring retraining whenever the catalog changes.
